videos.title: How Rolex makes Money
videos.description:
Have you ever wondered how big watch brands like Rolex make all their money? Well today we are explaining that. From their own foundry, to withholding watches from their customers. What is it that drives the companies revenue? Tony is willing to bet it is not what you expect.

Rolex does not just sell watches. It sells scarcity, status, resale value, and the feeling that you have made it.

In this video, Tony breaks down how Rolex makes money through controlled supply, waiting lists, the second-hand market, vertical integration, marketing, and one of the strongest luxury brands ever built.

From the Hans Wilsdorf Foundation to Bucherer, from the Daytona to the Submariner, this is how Rolex turned watches into one of the most powerful desire machines in the world.

videos.title: Why is the North Up?
videos.description:
Welcome to Tony - this is our first video, and we're kicking things off with a question you've probably never thought to ask.

North is up on every map you've ever seen. But there's no law that says it has to be. It's a choice - made by a handful of European mapmakers a few hundred years ago. Before that, maps pointed east, south, or whatever direction felt sacred to whoever was drawing them. This is the story of how north ended up on top, and why it very nearly didn't.

If you made it to the end thanks for watching. Subscribe if you want more - new video coming soon.
